data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for camera and microphone streaming via RTMP, SRT, RTSP, and WHIP/WHEP.
data.what_it_does: Provides unified video and audio recording and live streaming for Android and iOS. Supports protocols like RTMP, SRT, RTSP, UDP, and WHIP/WHEP, along with multi-streaming and custom filters.
use_when: You need to stream camera and microphone feeds via RTMP, SRT, or WHIP in a Flutter app.
You require a cross-platform solution supporting both Android and iOS for live broadcasting.
avoid_when: You only need standard local video playback without publishing or broadcasting.
You require full WHEP support on Android (WHEP is iOS-alpha only).
strengths: Supports multiple streaming protocols including RTMP, SRT, RTSP, and WHIP.
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS using modern native foundations (RootEncoder and HaishinKit).
Provides multi-streaming capabilities to stream to multiple destinations simultaneously.
weaknesses: Some protocols or advanced features (like WHEP or specific camera controls) differ between Android and iOS.
Requires platform-specific configuration for native build tools and lifecycle setups.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android build configurations (AGP, Gradle, Kotlin versions) and Xcode configurations such as UIScene lifecycle adoption for iOS.
